name: SP Legacy Testimonials Carousel
author: Shubham Patil

sections.description:
SP Legacy Testimonials Carousel offers a clean, accessible testimonial carousel designed to showcase client reviews and feedback cleanly without slowing down your site.

Key Features

  • Fully responsive layout (mobile-optimized).
  • Managed via a clean WordPress Custom Post Type (CPT).
  • Conditional asset loading (CSS and JS are enqueued only when the shortcode is detected on the page).
  • Lightweight Vanilla JS implementation (no jQuery dependency).
  • Accessible navigation controls.
sections.installation:
1. Upload sp-legacy-testimonials-carousel to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Testimonials” in the sidebar menu to add your testimonials.
  4. Place the shortcode [spltc_testimonials] on any post or page.
sections.faq:
How do I display the testimonial slider?

Simply use the shortcode [spltc_testimonials] in any page editor, Divi Code module, Elementor shortcode block, or Gutenberg block.

short_description: A lightweight, responsive, and performance-optimized auto-sliding testimonial widget managed via WP Admin.
